_note: Which effect tags each style forbids, derived from the style's own forbidden list. scripts/validate.js rejects a vfx-plan that uses a banned tag. window: in = starts at 0 s of the panel; out = ends on the panel's last frame; hit = short, anywhere; whole = runs the whole panel (duration 0 in the library means "use the panel length").
photosensitivity: No more than 3 flashes in any one second (flash-tagged effects, strobe every >= 3 frames at 30 fps is the ceiling) [CHECK against WCAG 2.3.1 before publishing].
